metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent launched GIMP and repeatedly tried File > Open Location with various HKU logo URLs. All network requests timed out after 50 turns without successfully downloading any image.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can launch GIMP, open menus (File/Edit), navigate dialog boxes, type in text fields
metadata.failure_analysis: Network access to HKU logo URLs timed out. Agent demonstrated GIMP navigation skills but not file creation.
metadata.task_rationale: Simplified to a local GIMP preferences task targeting icon-theme change, using the demonstrated capability of navigating GIMP menus.
metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating to Edit > Preferences > Interface and selecting the Symbolic icon theme. Evaluator reads gimprc and checks icon-theme field equals 'symbolic'. [Fixed: renamed function suffix from truncated '2aad73b8' (8 chars) to full MD5 hash 'a072fad36e1102073ae062e8b644b246' (32 chars) in getter, metric, and evaluator config]
fix_history: Fix 1: Replaced invalid 8-char suffix '2aad73b8' with correct 32-char MD5 hash 'a072fad36e1102073ae062e8b644b246' (computed as md5('5ca86c6f-f317-49d8-b6a7-b527541caae8|1')) in getter function name, metric function name, evaluator.func, and evaluator.result.type

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly reads /home/user/.config/GIMP/2.10/gimprc, the canonical GIMP preferences file, and parses the '(icon-theme ...)' line with accurate string slicing (offset 12) and quote-stripping logic.

Metric correctly uses expected.get('expected_icon_theme', 'symbolic') which is proper direct access since expected.type='rule' means the metric receives the rules dict {'expected_icon_theme': 'symbolic'} directly — no anti-pattern detected.
Case-insensitive comparison (both sides lowercased) correctly matches 'Symbolic' regardless of how GIMP serializes the value.
Single-requirement instruction is fully covered: evaluator checks exactly the icon-theme setting and nothing else is required.
File-based verification is stable; GIMP writes gimprc when the user clicks OK in the Preferences dialog, so no postconfig is needed.
Negative control resistance is adequate: the default GIMP icon theme is not 'Symbolic', so an unmodified initial state will return score 0.0.
Error handling is present: if gimprc is missing or icon-theme line is absent, the metric correctly returns 0.0.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: if gimprc has multiple (icon-theme ...) lines (unlikely but possible after manual edits), the getter takes the last one due to loop overwrite — this is reasonable but could be documented.

Consider adding a note that GIMP must have saved preferences (clicked OK in dialog) before evaluation; if the user navigated to the dialog but closed GIMP without saving, the file may be stale — this is expected GIMP behavior but worth documenting.
